in_marathi.name: Mamraj
in_marathi.long_meaning: Mamraj हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। In Hindu mythology, the name Mamraj is derived from the combination of two Sanskrit words: 'mama' meaning moon and 'raj' meaning delight. The name is given to a child born under the influence of the moon and is believed to bring happiness and prosperity.
